title: Sources: OpenAI is offering PE firms a guaranteed minimum return of 17.5% and early access to new models to secure JVs, an improvement on Anthropic's terms (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: OpenAI is offering PE firms a guaranteed minimum return of 17.5% and early access to new models to secure JVs, an improvement on Anthropic's terms — ChatGPT maker OpenAI is offering private-equity firms a sweeter deal than rival Anthropic as both artificial intelligence companies court buyout firms …
